# ghost/kin-nai-d

Kin Nai D (F-Droid): can't decide what to eat? Keep a list of foods and let the app pick one at random with a confetti reveal. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/kin-nai-d
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/kin-nai-d open_picker --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kin-nai-d add_food --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/kin-nai-d list_foods --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kin-nai-d remove_food --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/kin-nai-d spin --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_picker`: Open the Kin Nai D what to eat app
- `add_food`: Add Pizza to my list of foods
- `list_foods`: What foods are in my what-to-eat list?
- `remove_food`: Remove Pizza from my list of foods
- `spin`: Pick a random food for me to eat
